description: Shared rate limiter: take N units from a named bucket (limit per window, atomic) and learn whether you may go ahead, how many remain and when it resets. Keeps a fleet of agents under an API's quota or your own budget. cost=0 just peeks. Costs $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

space.description: Optional shared namespace (any secret string): agents using the same space share it. Default: your paying wallet.
